records.label: Edit core WordPress emails (new user, password reset, password and email change, comment notifications, admin notices) or turn them off
records.notes: Better Notifications for WP, WP Mail SMTP email controls. Filters: wp_new_user_notification_email, retrieve_password_message, password_change_email, email_change_email, comment_notification_text (https://developer.wordpress.org/reference/hooks/). Security emails such as password reset can be restyled but not disabled.

coverage.notes: Gap closure 2026-11-20: editing, hiding and reverting objects WordPress, themes or other plugins already register.
